description: Tests that after done+passing code+walkthrough, agent enters assessment mode with direct questions. Agent should be in assessment phase.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate who has finished a working hash map solution and just walked the interviewer through it. The tests passed. You're waiting for their wrap-up assessment.
simulated_user.first_message: Alright, so that's the full solution with the hash map. What else do you want to go over?

partial_conversation_history.message: I'll use a hash map — store values and check complements in one pass.
Done coding — I think it looks good.

Sure. As I iterate, for each element I check if the complement is in the hash map. If yes, return the pair. Otherwise add the current value. O(n) time, O(n) space. It handles duplicates and edge cases.
Good explanation. The tests all pass.

evaluation_criteria.name: Moves to assessment naturally
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: After a working solution was walked through and tests passed, the agent shifted to assessment/wrap-up behavior — asking direct reflective questions rather than staying in implementation mode or pushing for more code. PASS if the behavior reflected an assessment-phase mindset.
